# Per-test coverage overlap

## Method

The script reads per-test V8 coverage from the gzip-compressed JSONL file. The baseline threshold is more than 5% of successful test files (44.45 files; any source line covered by at least 45 files is removed). It reports 5,674 baseline lines across 679 source files. Lines in `lib/database/testing/**`, `migrations/**`, `lib/config/**`, and named test helpers/testing utilities are also excluded unless that path is the current test's inferred module under test. On the remaining distinctive lines, A-in-B containment requires at least 90% and at least 10 distinctive lines in A. Module-focused containment independently compares A's covered lines in its inferred same-basename module (or `index.ts[x]`) against every other test; it requires at least 90%. These are coverage overlaps, not proof of equivalent assertions.
